_comment: A Spearmen block (48 men, 12 files, facing north) held against the south face of the default hill (Rect2(1150, 380, 250, 200)), its front rank's slots 2 wu inside the hill's margin: a band one body radius (4.5 wu) wide around the hill that the soldier terrain backstop keeps every body out of. No orders: the block just stands. The front rank stands on the margin's edge (y = 584.5) from the first tick and stays there with no jitter, no man ever enters the hill, and the block's centre slides 2 wu south, away from the hill, until its slots clear the margin (y 596.0 -> 598.0, settled by about tick 180 and pinned at 300). Once settled no body moves, so the render stops rewriting the block. Drill mode: no opponent.
